question: Would spaces around api or a higher candidate limit fix R19? State the required ordering and parsing.

criteria.instruction: Neither fixes all semantics. Validate supported field/single-token term, authorize project and active eligibility before ranking/limits, tokenize only that field with ASCII alphanumeric runs and punctuation boundaries, then use existing order/limit. Space wrapping misses declared hyphen/underscore boundaries and concatenation still loses field scope. Raising limits does not repair substring/field errors.
Use R19 and pending review with r29 inspection and the equal-scope candidate example.
Do not silently search all fields/notes on unknown field, multi-token input or no selected-field hit; do not tune ranking without approval.
